scripts.deploy: node scripts/with-aws-env.js npx serverless deploy --stage prod
scripts.deploy:dev: node scripts/with-aws-env.js npx serverless deploy --stage dev
scripts.package: node scripts/with-aws-env.js npx serverless package --stage prod
scripts.info: node scripts/with-aws-env.js npx serverless info --stage prod
scripts.remove: node scripts/with-aws-env.js npx serverless remove --stage dev
scripts.bootstrap: node scripts/with-aws-env.js aws cloudformation deploy --template-file infra/bootstrap.yml --stack-name fastapi-app-cicd-bootstrap --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM
scripts.pipeline: node scripts/with-aws-env.js aws cloudformation deploy --template-file infra/codepipeline.yml --stack-name fastapi-app-pipeline --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM
